title: Local class formula for the explicit truncated counit
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes with the shared derived module categories, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$. Let $e$ be the explicit upper-truncation counit edge of [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. With the canonical local-class map $\Theta$, local Leray comparison $\lambda$, and inverse-open local-class map computed on the same K-injective representative [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf, lem-pc-ringed-space-sheafification-cohomology], every open $V\subseteq S$ satisfies $\Theta^{Rg_*K}_V\,\Gamma(V,e)=\lambda_{g,K,V}\,\Theta^K_{g^{-1}V}$, in diagrammatic composition order. No choice of source object or arbitrary derived morphism appears, and no lower bound on $K$ is imposed.

source.place: Tags 079W, 0BKJ, 0D5X; derived.tex Tags 08J5, 06XS. Agent refinement of the top-edge argument.

proof.text: Construct a natural local-class edge e_K and its normalized values on all single complexes by sheafifying the local cocycle maps. This construction involves no derived adjunction.

Prove naturality of the explicit truncated counit from naturality of upper truncation, of its inverse Hq inclusion, of the derived adjunction transpose, and of kappa. This is an equality of ordinary adjunction transposes after cancelling kappa.

The normalized derived adjunction on a single complex gives the explicit truncated counit the same value as e after precomposition with Hq of the single direct-image comparison. That comparison is invertible, so the two edges agree on singles.

The right-derived functor preserves lower bounds, by its bounded-below compatibility. Any two natural edges Hq(RK) -> F(Hq K) agreeing on singles agree on all K: first project K to J=tau_{>=q}K and cancel F(Hq of the projection); then include P=tau_{<=q}J into J. P is a single, and Hq of R(P -> J) is invertible because R(tau_{>=q+1}J) has zero H^{q-1} and Hq. The homology sequence of the truncation triangle proves this last isomorphism.
Apply this uniqueness to the two edges. Replacing e_K by the equal truncated counit in its local-class equation is exactly the required conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem topEdgeTruncatedCounit_localClass {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S)
    (q : ℤ) (K : schemeDerivedCategory T) :
    ∀ V : (Opens S)ᵒᵖ,
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass S.toRingedSpace q
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj K)).app V ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)).map
          (topEdgeTruncatedCounit g q K)).hom.app V =
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom q K).hom.app V ≫
        (RingedSpace.topEdgeInverseLocalClass g.toLRSHom.toShHom q K).app V
